body:
The accepted T37 assembly rounds its outer witness to a 10^-18 objective grid. Replaying the same complete construction on a strict 10^-24 grid gives the exact conditional bound

**κ = 1661960547713947858091 / 10^24 = 0.001661960547713947858091**,

an increase of **858091/10^24** over the selected **0.001661960547713947**. This is an extremely small numerical certification refinement, with no new circuit or practical runtime claim.

**Status: conditional bound.** Exact base: `8bddbee377e2f3ce1f1247196c4b290d55767d20`; OS seed **24**, complex-supplier track. Only `research/t37-rational-refinement/` is added; the selected record and all original sources remain untouched.

The fresh full assembly reproduces the original output exactly, then replays the entire refined assembly. All **876 selected source files** match, all **47 strict constraints** pass, and both moment-engine tables, both seven-step bootstrap chains and every invoice input digest are unchanged. The 1024-bit complex charge, 2048-bit row extra, bit surcharge and all finite row/physical/tape/precision guards remain paid. The next fine-grid point is rejected. The exact source adaptation is three grid expressions; three derived kappa expectations and a hash-preserving portable pivot path are updated in the temporary specification.

Reproduce with standard-library Python 3.11+:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/t37-rational-refinement/verify.py
python3 -I -B research/t37-rational-refinement/test_package.py
```

Expected: `PASS_T37_RATIONAL_REFINEMENT kappa=0.001661960547713947858091 sources=876 full_assembly=PASS strict_constraints=47 controls=7`, then `PASS_T37_REFINEMENT_PACKAGE relocated_full_assembly=PASS controls=8`.

Seven controls reject finer/coarser adjacent points, zero eta/beta, insufficient complex/row charges and under-reported primitives. Eight package controls pass from a minimal standalone source closure with spaces in its path. The source-bound selected-record and whitespace checks pass. The full exact assembly, adaptation receipt, source pins and logs are reproducible; no receipt was edited into a pass.

Native geometry, ownership, emission and cold-ancestry evidence are inherited from the immutable maintainer-reviewed construction. This performs fresh complete pricing and assembly, rather than a new native emission. All-size/compiler, physical realization, precision/tape/recovery and analytic assumptions remain conditional; no full Lean or unconditional multiplication theorem is claimed.

Repeated full open-PR inventories and all-state searches found no matching finer-grid contribution. PR942's all-T 10^-18 grid result is preserved; no real-root or architecture-wide optimum is claimed. Larger pending PR987/1004/1005 use different local words and are not imported or treated as accepted. Jonathan Capalbo, Chafik Boukhalfa, Hao Yan, Jeremy Kothe and the full supplier/engine lineage retain credit. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and Apache-2.0 terms are disclosed in NOTICE.md. No pinned sprint coordination issue existed; the claim is local.
title: Conditional κ = 0.001661960547713947858091 by exact T37 grid refinement
